check_sql: SELECT country_key, year, source_key, generation_twh FROM dw.fact_generation_annual WHERE generation_twh < 0

description: Generation-mix shares sum to 100% ± 1 per country-year
check_sql: SELECT country_key, year, SUM(share_pct) AS share_sum FROM dw.fact_generation_annual GROUP BY country_key, year HAVING SUM(generation_twh) > 0 AND ABS(SUM(share_pct) - 100) > 1

description: No gaps in a country's year range
check_sql: SELECT country_key, MIN(year) AS first_year, MAX(year) AS last_year, COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS years FROM dw.fact_country_annual GROUP BY country_key HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year) <> MAX(year) - MIN(year) + 1
